purpose: Measure actual source-to-compact-bank integration and whole-pilot cost while retaining useful Ceres labels. No training or strength comparison.

selection.selection_rule: First complete canonical shard, selected before teacher outputs; not representative sampling

execution.policy: Full legal support, compact indices and raw gathered logits
execution.value: Primary W/D/L logits, side to move; no value2 or native head blend

resources.scope: Includes startup, preflight, bounded lease waiting, calls, readback and cleanup; sampled resource ceilings can transiently overshoot.

acceptance: All 8192 rows and 256 fixed32 calls, with no padding/drop/replacement
Complete eight-array bank and unchanged source/row/feed bindings
Finite native logits, actual CUDA neural proof and only allowed small integer/bool CPU shape kernels
Actual first/final library and source identities pass; imports or one shard alone are insufficient
Successful parent and outer terminal receipts plus independent bank review
stopping: STOP, deadline, resource, source, mapping, dtype/finiteness or provider failure ends attempt; preserve evidence and partial output. No automatic retry or expansion.

prior_evidence.profile: Accepted approximate fixed32 research backend; original strict parity/provenance failures remain failed
prior_evidence.same_batch_repeat: Policy and primary value outputs byte-identical across two saved fixed32 runs
prior_evidence.limitations: 128 saved inputs do not prove arbitrary batch contexts, final padding, native repetition edges, value calibration or strength; first shard does not establish full-corpus cost.

analysis: Report end-to-end elapsed, row coverage and storage, with synchronous session-call time separately. No repeated 128 reference inference just for bookkeeping; copied-library/input proof reuse is not new GPU integration proof.
evidence_scope: Curated scientific/settings/hash projection; original operational plans, commands and logs remain external.
